rows.Kwic: 上堂：茫茫盡是覓佛漢，舉世難尋閑道人。棒喝交馳成藥忌，了亡藥忌未天真。

Override.AttributionNote: Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 1–33 (五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)): in his hall address, Pan'an Jicheng contrasts a world of buddha-seekers with the rarity of an at-ease person of the Way.
